option.value: Avoid overly verbose descriptions or unnecessary details. Use the Conventional Commit Format.

list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(dashboard): enhance attendance tracking and live session status
- Added "Recent Activity" section to display recent visits with timestamps and durations. - Introduced live session status to indicate when a user is currently in the facility. - Improved attendance history handling with better API response parsing and sorting. - Simplified state management by removing redundant comments and refining logic. - Enhanced UX with updated check-in banners and structured attendance visualization.

task.summary: Default task

fix(proxy): add CORS headers for `/api/auth` to handle cross-origin requests
- Implemented CORS headers to explicitly allow subdomains of `dsmhgroup.com`. - Ensured compatibility for cross-origin API authentication requests.

fix(proxy): add CORS headers for `/api/auth` to handle cross-origin requests
- Implemented CORS headers to explicitly allow subdomains of `dsmhgroup.com`. - Ensured compatibility for cross-origin API authentication requests.

fix(consoleClient): update membership lookup to use `domain` instead of `slug`
- Adjusted logic to prioritize `domain` for tenant matching in `consoleClient.tsx`. - Updated IntelliJ workspace with recent task history changes.

fix(membership): adjust server fetch for role lookup with safer headers handling
- Updated `membership.ts` to use `next/headers` for secure cookie and tenant ID forwarding. - Simplified conditional rendering in `TenantSidebarManager.tsx` for better readability.

fix(membership): improve membership role resolution logic
- Refactored `membership.ts` to isolate and match active tenant membership accurately. - Enhanced error handling and added debug logging for missing memberships. - Simplified role extraction for better maintainability.
Fixed sidebar error
Fixed sidebar error again
Moved to client side
Obscene logs
Updated stuff

fix(proxy): enhance tenant routing and logging for improved debugging
- Added detailed trace logging to improve visibility in the routing pipeline. - Adjusted internal asset guard conditions and streamlined subdomain detection logic. - Enhanced handling of CORS headers for `/api/auth` requests with stricter evaluation of allowed origins. - Improved backend resolution error handling and tenant metadata parsing. - Refined routing rewrite behavior for tenant-specific paths.

feat(members): implement live member roster sync and invitation workflow
- Integrated live data fetching with `react-query` for tenant membership roster. - Added secure member invitation workflow with email and phone input support. - Enhanced filtering, search, and display logic for dynamic roster management. - Improved UX/UI with loading, error handling, and KPI summary enhancements.

feat(dialog): add accessible and customizable dialog component
- Introduced a new `Dialog` component with full accessibility using `@base-ui/react/dialog`. - Added support for customizable overlays, headers, footers, and close buttons. - Improved usability with slot-based architecture and utility-first styling.

refactor(members): simplify `MembersPage` by removing unused server-side logic
- Removed redundant `fetchTenantMembers` and interface definitions. - Refactored `MembersPage` to rely on `tenantId` header directly for client-side handling.

feat(invites): add pending invites management and UI integration
- Built `InvitesPage` with server-side handling of tenant data. - Created `InvitesClient` for managing pending invites using `react-query`. - Added UI for viewing, resending, and revoking invitations within the admin panel. - Updated sidebar to include an "Invites" section for improved navigation.

feat(register): redesign registration form with invitation flow support
- Simplified and modernized `RegisterForm` UI for a better user experience. - Added support for workspace invitations, including pre-filled email fields and redirection to tenant-specific domains. - Integrated `toast` notifications for error and success feedback during registration. - Optimized form logic to remove unnecessary steps and improve onboarding efficiency. - Introduced `Suspense` wrapper for improved client search parameter handling.

feat(invites): add copy magic link functionality to admin invites panel
- Introduced new "Copy Magic Link" button for generating and copying magic links to the clipboard. - Implemented toast notifications for success or failure when copying the link. - Enhanced user experience with quick access to shareable invitation links via the admin panel.

feat(invites): add copy magic link functionality to admin invites panel
- Introduced new "Copy Magic Link" button for generating and copying magic links to the clipboard. - Implemented toast notifications for success or failure when copying the link. - Enhanced user experience with quick access to shareable invitation links via the admin panel.

feat(dashboard): implement workspace grid and athlete metrics components
- Added `WorkspaceGrid` for displaying user workspaces with role-specific actions. - Introduced `AthleteMetrics` for tracking attendance, personal records, and weekly performance. - Updated global dashboard page with role-based workspace management and metric insights. - Refactored `dashboardClient` to modularize components and simplify state handling.
fix(dashboard): update user profile endpoint in `dashboardClient` for data consistency

feat(sidebar): refactor `TenantSidebarManager` with unified role-based navigation
- Introduced `getRoleConfig` for centralized role-based navigation configuration. - Replaced individual role-specific sidebars with a unified `UnifiedSidebar` component. - Improved code readability and maintainability by reducing duplication. - Added support for badge notifications and simplified error and loading states. - Enhanced user experience with dynamic role-based themes and streamlined API calls.

fix(layout): add input validation and fix UI layout inconsistencies
- Added hex string validation to `hexToHslString` to prevent crashes on malformed inputs. - Fixed viewport and scrolling issues by updating layout classes (`min-h-screen` -> `h-screen`, added `overflow-hidden`). - Ensured consistent sidebar and mobile nav behavior (`h-full`, `shrink-0`, pinned elements).

feat(invites): add `InviteMemberSheet` component and refactor invite workflow
- Introduced `InviteMemberSheet` for inviting users to a workspace with role selection, email, and phone inputs. - Replaced redundant inline logic in `MembersClient` with the new component for improved modularity. - Enhanced maintainability by centralizing shared invite logic and UI.

fix(ui): adjust layout spacing and width for form and button components
- Added `px-6` padding for better horizontal spacing on `InviteMemberSheet` form. - Set button width to `w-full` in `consoleClient` for improved visual consistency.

feat(ui): display member roles and improve table structure in `MembersClient`
- Added a new "ROLE" column to the members table for displaying user roles. - Improved role badges with dynamic theming based on role type (e.g., staff, member). - Updated table structure to accommodate the new column, ensuring responsive layout.

feat(dashboard): refactor user dashboard data fetching to use React Query for improved performance
- Replaced server-side user metrics fetching with client-side data aggregation via React Query. - Implemented parallel API calls for user, membership, bookings, and attendance data in `DashboardClient`. - Enhanced loading and error states with user-friendly visuals and toasts. - Simplified state handling and dynamic data preparation for better maintainability. - Removed legacy mock data and server-to-server fetch utility.

feat(payments): refactor PaymentsClient for React Query integration and improved user experience
- Migrated payment data fetching to React Query for better performance and state management. - Improved loading and error states with user-friendly visuals. - Added token top-up and subscription upgrade workflows with modals for seamless interactions. - Simplified server-to-client data aggregation by removing legacy server-fetch logic.

feat(settings): refactor `SettingsClient` with React Query and live plan management
- Replaced legacy `fetchTenantProfileSettings` function with React Query for better data handling. - Implemented live membership plan CRUD operations, including adding, editing, and deleting plans. - Optimized plan-related API calls to execute concurrently for improved performance. - Enhanced user experience with loading states, error handling, and toast notifications. - Simplified `page.tsx` by removing unused server-fetch logic and updating prop handling.

fix(settings): improve plan state management and optimize CRUD handling
- Refactored `updateLocalPlan` to use plan IDs instead of array indices for more reliable updates. - Enhanced membership plan CRUD operations with stricter execution flow to prevent overlaps. - Updated API payloads to enforce proper data types (e.g., numbers for prices and tokens). - Removed redundant comments and improved code readability across local state and API handlers. - Minimized repeated JSX by consolidating inline formatting and layouts.

fix(settings): update state structure for improved readability and maintainability
- Reformatted and indented JSX structures for better clarity. - Enhanced readability of object initialization and multiline props in settings components. - Made minor adjustments to layouts by standardizing class names and spacing.

fix(sidebar): reformat and clean up JSX structure in `TenantSidebarManager`
- Standardized JSX formatting and spacing for improved readability. - Streamlined object properties, props, and class name usage. - Enhanced code maintainability by reducing visual clutter.

feat(sidebar): refactor role-based navigation structure in `TenantSidebarManager`
- Introduced `generateSidebarConfig` to dynamically generate role-based navigation groups. - Simplified role handling and replaced `RoleConfig` with new `NavGroup` and `SidebarConfig` interfaces. - Updated `UnifiedSidebar` to support multiple navigation groups and dynamic role displays. - Improved design consistency with revamped layout, spacing, and updated icon sizes.

fix(settings): simplify `SettingsClient` by modularizing membership plans
- Extracted membership plan handling logic into a new `MembershipPlans` component. - Removed unnecessary state management and redundant API logic in `SettingsClient`. - Standardized code formatting and updated imports to maintain consistency.

fix(settings): refactor `MembershipPlans` component for improved CRUD functionality
- Simplified state management by removing redundant local plan tracking. - Enhanced API integration for creating, updating, and deleting plans with streamlined handlers. - Improved user experience with add/edit form, validation, and optimized UI feedback. - Updated table structure for better readability and responsive design.

feat(settings): integrate `GymProfile` component in `SettingsClient` and standardize formatting
- Replaced inline gym profile configuration with the modular `GymProfile` component for better maintainability. - Standardized imports and JSX formatting across the file to improve code consistency. - Refined mock state handling to align with other non-integrated tabs.

fix(settings): refactor `GymProfile` for React Query updates and formatting improvements
- Migrated deprecated query callback to `useEffect` for better reactivity with React Query data. - Standardized import ordering and JSX formatting for improved readability. - Enhanced fallback handling in profile fields with streamlined logic and default values.

feat(settings): modularize team management with `TeamMembers` component
- Extracted team management functionality into a new `TeamMembers` component for better maintainability and reusability. - Implemented React Query for real-time staff profiles and role updates. - Added onboarding invitation workflow with form validation and success/error handling. - Standardized code structure by removing inline logic and redundant state management in `SettingsClient`.

feat(settings): enhance `TeamMembers` component with self-protection logic and UI improvements
- Added safeguards to prevent self-modification of roles/status in the `TeamMembers` component. - Integrated additional UI enhancements, including disabled states for buttons and improved accessibility. - Refactored and optimized JSX formatting and props handling for better readability and maintainability.

feat(settings): log user profile data for debugging in `TeamMembers`
- Added console logs for `currentUserProfile` and `person.userId` to assist with debugging self-protection logic. - Minor adjustments for improved traceability during runtime.

feat(admin): add `ManageMemberSheet` for member lifecycle and subscriptions management
- Introduced `ManageMemberSheet` component for managing member status, active plans, token balance, and RFID assignments. - Integrated React Query for fetching member details, subscription plans, and invoices. - Added manual payment functionality with real-time ledger updates. - Enhanced UI with segmented forms and status controls for better usability.

feat(invites): enhance `InviteMemberSheet` with improved validation and UX
- Added full name field with validation to ensure proper input. - Implemented strict Sri Lankan phone number normalization and validation. - Removed role selection to default all invites to "Member" role. - Updated UI components for better clarity and usability, including dynamic phone field prefix handling.
feat(invites): adjust padding in `InviteMemberSheet` for improved layout consistency
fix(invites): adjust padding in `InviteMemberSheet` for layout consistency and spacing improvements

fix(layout): remove cache configuration in `tenantId` fetch logic in layout file
- Removed `revalidate: 300` from fetch request headers for `tenantId` data.

feat(payments): add pending invoice payment flow and improve UI feedback
- Introduced pending invoice payment functionality with real-time updates and success/error handling. - Added action-required banners for unpaid invoices with contextual messages. - Updated UI components for better state management and usability, including conditional disabling of actions for pending users. - Enhanced invoice table with improved status indicators.

feat(admin): enhance `ManageMemberSheet` with new UI components and functionality
- Replaced dropdowns with `Select` components for status and plan selection. - Improved state handling by setting default values for `activePlanId` and member status. - Added query invalidation for real-time `tenantMembersGrid` updates on success. - Enhanced manual payment handling with accurate invoice details and improved error feedback. - Refined UI for better usability, including adjusted invoice layout and button styles.

feat(payments): integrate PayHere checkout and enhance payment flows
- Added PayHere SDK for secure payment processing. - Centralized payment gateway initialization with real-time status handlers for success, dismissal, and errors. - Updated invoice and subscription flows to trigger PayHere checkout instead of immediate status changes. - Injected asynchronous PayHere script and improved TypeScript global object handling. - Enhanced UX with toast notifications and UI feedback for seamless user experience.

feat(payments): refine PayHere integration and improve payment flows
- Added contextual "Renew Plan" button for active plan checkouts. - Enhanced state management by removing redundant comments and simplifying logic. - Improved TypeScript global object handling for better PayHere SDK integration. - Updated subscription and invoice workflows with clear UX feedback and error handling.

feat(dashboard): enhance attendance tracking and live session status
- Added "Recent Activity" section to display recent visits with timestamps and durations. - Introduced live session status to indicate when a user is currently in the facility. - Improved attendance history handling with better API response parsing and sorting. - Simplified state management by removing redundant comments and refining logic. - Enhanced UX with updated check-in banners and structured attendance visualization.
